signal: Alianza completed its acquisition of Metaswitch from Microsoft, now serving 1,000-plus communication service providers including 19 of the top 20 global operators

email.body1:
Jon, saw Alianza closed the Metaswitch acquisition and now serves over 1,000 communication service providers, including 19 of the top 20 operators.

Scaling a base that fast usually means more strategic accounts in play than the team can cover, and that is where deals quietly stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Alianza off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jon, quick follow-up for Alianza.

After folding in Metaswitch, the strategic account base grows faster than your selling capacity can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to cover it, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your strategic accounts team needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jon, last bit of proof for Alianza.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Alianza's reply rate likely compares to other communications software firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jon, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling strategic account pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating an acquisition the size of Metaswitch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a strategic accounts motion? I will tailor it to Alianza either way.
